newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-SHEFFIELD SHIELD CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SHEFFIELD SHIELD CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.

text.p: Scores at the close of play on the third day of four-day Sheffield Shield cricket matches on Sunday:
In Adelaide: South Australia 137 and 174-6 (Martin Faull 68, Darren Lehmann 62 not out); New South Wales 415 (Corey Richards 76) and 173-3 (Rodney Davison 67 not out)
In Perth: Victoria 332 (Rohan Larkin 104) and 221-6 (Graeme Vampini 88, Dean Jones 75); Western Australia 495 (Mike Hussey 147, Damien Martyn 108).
